mapper.select: SELECT RESOURCE_ID, SCHEMA_NAME, OBJECT_NAME, RESOURCE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, ENABLED FROM DATA_RESOURCE WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = #{schemaName} ORDER BY OBJECT_NAME, RESOURCE_ID
SELECT DEPT_ID, DEPT_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS U WHERE U.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID AND U.ENABLED = 'Y') AS ACTIVE_ACCOUNT_COUNT FROM DEPARTMENT D ORDER BY DEPT_NAME, DEPT_ID

SELECT #{resourceId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS RESOURCE_ID, D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME, P.POLICY_ID, R.ACCESS_LEVEL, R.EXPORT_POLICY, P.ENABLED AS POLICY_ENABLED FROM DEPARTMENT D LEFT JOIN DATA_ACCESS_POLICY P ON P.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID AND P.RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} JOIN DATA_RESOURCE R ON R.RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} ORDER BY D.DEPT_NAME, D.DEPT_ID, P.POLICY_ID

SELECT R.RESOURCE_ID, R.SCHEMA_NAME, R.OBJECT_NAME, R.RESOURCE_NAME, R.DESCRIPTION, R.ENABLED FROM DATA_RESOURCE R WHERE R.SCHEMA_NAME = #{schemaName} AND R.ENABLED = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DATA_ACCESS_POLICY P WHERE P.RESOURCE_ID = R.RESOURCE_ID AND P.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND P.ENABLED = 'Y' AND P.ACCESS_DECISION = 'ALLOW' ) ORDER BY R.OBJECT_NAME, R.RESOURCE_ID
SELECT RESOURCE_ID, SCHEMA_NAME, OBJECT_NAME, RESOURCE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, ENABLED, ACCESS_LEVEL, EXPORT_POLICY FROM DATA_RESOURCE ORDER BY SCHEMA_NAME, OBJECT_NAME
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DATA_RESOURCE WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = #{schemaName} AND OBJECT_NAME = #{objectName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DATA_RESOURCE (RESOURCE_ID, SCHEMA_NAME, OBJECT_NAME, RESOURCE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, ENABLED, ACCESS_LEVEL, EXPORT_POLICY) VALUES (#{resourceId}, #{schemaName}, #{objectName}, #{resourceName}, #{description}, 'Y', 'GENERAL', 'BLOCK')
mapper.update: UPDATE DATA_RESOURCE SET ACCESS_LEVEL = #{accessLevel}, EXPORT_POLICY = #{exportPolicy}, ENABLED = #{enabled} WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId}
UPDATE DATA_ACCESS_POLICY SET ACCESS_DECISION = 'ALLOW', ENABLED = 'Y' WHERE POLICY_ID = #{policyId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM DATA_ACCESS_POLICY WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND DEPT_ID NOT IN #{deptId}
mapper.select: SELECT POLICY_ID FROM DATA_ACCESS_POLICY WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND DEPT_ID = #{deptId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DATA_ACCESS_POLICY (POLICY_ID, RESOURCE_ID, DEPT_ID, ACCESS_DECISION, ENABLED) VALUES (#{policyId}, #{resourceId}, #{deptId}, 'ALLOW', 'Y')
mapper.select: SELECT RESOURCE_ID, DEPT_ID, POLICY_ID FROM DATA_ACCESS_POLICY WHERE RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND ENABLED = 'Y' AND ACCESS_DECISION = 'ALLOW' ORDER BY DEPT_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀'
